layman: An ache felt behind or around the eyes, often worse with eye movement

label: Frothy or bubbly urine
layman: Urine that looks unusually frothy or bubbly, a common sign of protein leaking into the urine

label: Dry, red, flaky patches
layman: Dry, reddish, flaking skin

label: Worse for distance, near vision is fine
layman: Far-away objects are the blurry ones

label: Worse for near/reading, distance vision is fine
layman: Close-up/reading is the blurry part

label: Blurry for both near and distance
layman: Everything looks blurred, near and far alike

label: Pain on pulling the earlobe or pressing the tragus
layman: Pulling the ear or pressing the little flap in front of it hurts

label: Small joints of the fingers/wrists, often both sides
layman: Mainly the fingers and wrists

label: Large weight-bearing joints (knees/hips)
layman: Mainly the knees or hips

label: Sharp, tearing pain when passing a stool
layman: It hurts sharply to pass a stool

label: Pain began with no injury at all
layman: It started without any fall, knock or strain
